name: QA 2009
description:
PCP QA Test No. 2009

Exercise pmda_proc acct(5) expiry garbage collection under valgrind.



This is a regression test for a use-after-free in free_entry():

__pmHashDel() frees the hash node itself, so node->data must be saved

before the call instead of being dereferenced afterwards.
